newsitem.title: USA: Summa Four names Degan chief executive.
newsitem.headline: Summa Four names Degan chief executive.

text.p: Summa Four Inc said it has named Robert Degan as president and chief executive officer, effective January 1997.
The company said Edward Callahan, its former president and chief operating officer, has left the company.

It said Degan brings more than twenty years of senior management experience at a variety of companies in the data communications and switching industry, with a solid record of fiscal and corporate growth. Most recently, Degan was president and CEO of TyLink Corporation, a Massachusetts based maker of switched digital access products.
